title: Notification path becomes async void and blocks on an HTTP call

consumerGuidance.architecture: ASP.NET Core Web API. Controllers await application services; there is no event-based UI framework in this project.
consumerGuidance.notes: Unhandled exceptions on a request thread are logged by the host; exceptions from void-returning continuations terminate the process.

mustCite: the change of NotifyAsync to async void NotifyPlaced
the controller call site that can no longer await or observe the work
the consequence that a failure escapes as an unobserved exception on the synchronization context rather than failing the request
the correction of returning Task and awaiting it at the caller
that the call sits on the request path reached from OrdersController
the consequence of blocking a request thread and wrapping failures in AggregateException

forbiddenFindings.example: Requiring ConfigureAwait(false), ValueTask or Task.Run because the project is ASP.NET Core.
Objecting to the NotifyPlaced method name or the string interpolation style.
Requiring an outbox, message bus or CQRS pipeline to send the notification.

notes: Both defects are on the same changed method. The project has no event contract, which is what makes async void a defect here rather than a preference.
